ORDEM_BRIDGE.App.Title: Connect to Ordem
ORDEM_BRIDGE.App.Heading: World connection
ORDEM_BRIDGE.App.Subtitle: Link this world to the portal without copying tokens or technical identifiers.
ORDEM_BRIDGE.Settings.Connection.Name: Ordem da Última Luz
ORDEM_BRIDGE.Settings.Connection.Label: Manage connection
ORDEM_BRIDGE.Settings.Connection.Hint: Connect this world, monitor the Bridge and synchronize characters.
ORDEM_BRIDGE.Onboarding.Title: Bring this world to the portal
ORDEM_BRIDGE.Onboarding.Description: The portal will recognize this world, ask an authorized person to choose its campaign and complete the connection automatically.
ORDEM_BRIDGE.Onboarding.Permission: The campaign is selected and validated in the portal
ORDEM_BRIDGE.Pairing.Title: Authorize this world in the portal
ORDEM_BRIDGE.Pairing.Description: This screen updates automatically after authorization.
ORDEM_BRIDGE.Pairing.Step1Text: Use the button below to open a new tab.
ORDEM_BRIDGE.Pairing.Step2Text: The portal shows only campaigns you can manage.
ORDEM_BRIDGE.Pairing.Step3Text: Review this world's data and authorize the connection.
ORDEM_BRIDGE.Pairing.ExpiredTitle: This code is no longer valid
ORDEM_BRIDGE.Pairing.ExpiredDescription: Generate a new code to continue. No connection was created.
ORDEM_BRIDGE.Connected.Description: Presence, characters and commands from this world are integrated with the portal.
ORDEM_BRIDGE.Connected.Passive: This browser is monitoring the connection. Only the active connector game master sends data to the portal.
ORDEM_BRIDGE.Characters.Title: World characters
ORDEM_BRIDGE.Characters.Description: Send the allowed information for every character actor now.
ORDEM_BRIDGE.Merchant.Title: Merchant
ORDEM_BRIDGE.Merchant.Description: Choose the actor whose item collection will be published as a catalog in the portal and Discord. This stage is read-only and does not move currency or inventory.
ORDEM_BRIDGE.Merchant.ActorHint: Item names, descriptions, categories, prices and quantities are sent as sanitized text.
ORDEM_BRIDGE.Merchant.NoActorsAvailable: This world has no actors yet. Create the Merchant and return to this screen.
ORDEM_BRIDGE.Merchant.MissingActor: The previously selected actor no longer exists. Choose another actor or clear the selection.
ORDEM_BRIDGE.Disconnect.Title: Disconnect this world
ORDEM_BRIDGE.Disconnect.Hint: Stops new synchronizations without deleting Foundry characters.
ORDEM_BRIDGE.Disconnect.Body: The portal will stop receiving presence, characters and commands from this world in {campaignName}. No character will be deleted.
ORDEM_BRIDGE.Technical.Title: Technical details and diagnostics
ORDEM_BRIDGE.Technical.UrlHint: Change this address only in development environments or when instructed by an administrator.
ORDEM_BRIDGE.Feedback.CopyFailed: The code could not be copied automatically. Select it and copy it manually.
ORDEM_BRIDGE.Feedback.MerchantSaved: Merchant selected. The first catalog has been synchronized.
ORDEM_BRIDGE.Feedback.MerchantSyncComple: Merchant catalog synchronized with the portal.
ORDEM_BRIDGE.Feedback.Retrying: Another attempt started. This screen will update automatically.
ORDEM_BRIDGE.Notifications.RegistrationR: Module enabled. Open the Ordem screen in settings to connect this world.
ORDEM_BRIDGE.Notifications.Registered: World securely connected to the Ordem portal.
ORDEM_BRIDGE.Errors.IncompatibleSystem: This module requires a Shadow of the Demon Lord world.
ORDEM_BRIDGE.Errors.PortalUnavailable: The portal could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
ORDEM_BRIDGE.Errors.GameMasterOnly: Only a game master can manage this world's connection.
ORDEM_BRIDGE.Errors.PrimaryGmOnly: Only the primary active game master can manage this world's connection.
ORDEM_BRIDGE.Errors.PrimaryChanged: The active game master changed. Start or resume pairing in the primary game master's browser.
ORDEM_BRIDGE.Errors.Revoked: This world's connection was revoked. Start a new pairing.
ORDEM_BRIDGE.Errors.CredentialReplaced: This browser's credential was replaced. Take over the connection again if needed.
ORDEM_BRIDGE.Errors.ServiceUpdate: The portal could not complete this update. Try again.
ORDEM_BRIDGE.Errors.MerchantMissing: The actor selected as Merchant no longer exists. Select another actor.
ORDEM_BRIDGE.Errors.MerchantRequired: Select an actor before synchronizing the Merchant.
ORDEM_BRIDGE.Errors.Unknown: The operation could not be completed.
